ui_bugs.issue: The patch described in the review request has NOT been applied. Line 108 is unchanged: `if (detail) return <PoDetail poId={detail} ... onQr={openQrLabels} user={user} />;` — a single bare element, not a Fragment. The `{labels && <LabelsPrintModal/>}` at line 179 lives in the main-return branch and is therefore never mounted while detail is active. Required patch: replace line 108 with `if (detail) return (<><PoDetail poId={detail} onBack={() => { setDetail(null); load(); }} onEdit={(p) => { setEdit(p); setOpen(true); setDetail(null); }} onReceive={(p) => { setReceive(p); setDetail(null); }} onPdf={printPdf} onXlsx={exportXlsx} onQr={openQrLabels} user={user} />{labels && <LabelsPrintModal labels={labels} onClose={() => setLabels(null)} />}</>);` — or hoist the whole thing into a single Fragment at the bottom.
